Complex work deserves more than one model.

Spine AI plans, delegates, reviews, and repairs complex work across many agents. Use Canvas in the cloud, or run Medley locally through the tools you already trust.

Canvas — cloud multi-agent work

Canvas assembles specialized agents across 300+ models to research, analyze, and produce sourced deliverables, websites, and apps. Canvas is SOC 2 Type I compliant.

Medley — local-first agent orchestration

Medley returns finished work within your constraints and permission boundaries, with the full history of evolving plans, adaptive graphs, and execution receipts behind it. Its local daemon and Claude Code or Codex plugins coordinate models and worker harnesses across research, analysis, software, and more.

Adaptive graphs, review, and repair

Both products grow the work graph as agents discover dependencies. Review can create repair branches that return for verification before completion.

State of the art across domains

At the time of evaluation, Canvas ranked first on GAIA Level 3 and DeepSearchQA in February 2026, while Medley reported new highs on Terminal-Bench 2.1, HealthBench Professional, ViBench, and DrugDiscoveryBench in July 2026. The July results exceeded published frontier-model baselines available then, including Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol.

Use cases by role

Investors

Market sizing, competitive landscapes, earnings analysis, and investment memos — from public filings and data.

  • Build a TAM/SAM/SOM model for [market] triangulating industry reports, public company disclosures, and analyst estimates — with sources, assumptions, and scenario tabs
  • Research 15+ companies in [sector], their positioning, funding, revenue signals, and key risks — produce an investment thesis memo with comparable valuations
  • Analyze the last 4 quarters of earnings calls for [company] and its 5 closest peers — extract sentiment shifts, guidance changes, and strategic pivots into a cross-company trend report
  • Research SEC filings, insider transactions, and 13F institutional ownership changes for [company] over the past 6 months — produce a smart money signals report with charts

Consultants

Industry landscapes, market sizing, due diligence, and competitive intelligence — client-ready in minutes.

  • Research the [industry] landscape: map the top 15 companies by segment, their positioning, pricing, funding, key customers, and the 3 most underserved segments — produce a strategy deck
  • Produce a market sizing report for [industry] with bottom-up and top-down estimates, triangulating industry reports, public disclosures, and analyst data — with methodology and source citations
  • Build a commercial due diligence report on [company]: market position, competitive moat, management team assessment, customer concentration risk, and key person dependencies — citing 20+ public sources
  • Produce a competitive intelligence brief across 10 competitors in [market]: pricing changes, product launches, executive hires, funding rounds, and regulatory actions from the past 90 days

Legal

Case law research, regulatory tracking, patent landscapes, and litigation prep — with citations.

  • Research [judge]'s last 50 rulings in [case type]: judicial philosophy, procedural preferences, sentencing patterns, plus opposing counsel's win rate and strategic tendencies — produce a litigation prep memo
  • Track all regulatory changes affecting [sector] in the past 12 months across federal and state agencies — produce a compliance impact report with deadlines, required disclosures, and action items
  • Map the patent landscape for [technology]: key patent holders, recent grants and applications, ongoing disputes, licensing structures, and freedom-to-operate analysis — produce a landscape report with claim charts
  • Research case law on [topic] across federal circuits and key state jurisdictions — produce an analysis brief with precedent chain, current circuit splits, and practical litigation guidance

Medical

Literature reviews, guideline comparisons, trial pipelines, and FDA safety monitoring — with citations.

  • Conduct a systematic literature review on [treatment] for [condition]: search PubMed, Cochrane, and recent RCTs — grade evidence quality using GRADE and produce a structured summary with 30+ citations
  • Compare current guidelines from AHA, ESC, NCCN, and WHO for [condition]: drug classes, dosing, sequencing, and monitoring — produce a side-by-side decision matrix with level-of-evidence ratings
  • Map the entire clinical trial pipeline for [disease area]: all active Phase II/III trials from ClinicalTrials.gov with mechanisms of action, sponsors, primary endpoints, enrollment status, and expected readout dates
  • Research all FDA drug safety communications, REMS modifications, and label changes in [therapeutic area] from the past 12 months — produce a pharmacovigilance report organized by drug class with clinical implications

Founders

Competitive landscapes, investor research, market intelligence, and buyer analysis — from public signals.

  • Map the competitive landscape for [market]: top 15 players with positioning, pricing, features, funding history, estimated revenue, employee count, and whitespace opportunities — produce a competitive matrix
  • Research the funding landscape for [sector]: who's investing at what stages and valuations, which companies raised recently, each major VC's thesis — produce a ranked investor target list for a [stage] startup
  • Deep-dive [competitor] from public signals: product launches from changelogs, hiring patterns from 50+ job postings, customer sentiment from G2/Reddit reviews, and pricing changes — produce a competitive intelligence dossier
  • Research the buyer landscape for [product category]: who buys (titles, company size), what they use today, pain points from G2/Reddit/forums, willingness to pay, and switching triggers — produce a buyer persona report

GTM & Sales

Account research, buyer intent signals, outreach personalization, and deal intelligence — from public footprints.

  • Research [target account]: org structure, recent initiatives, tech stack (from job postings), strategic priorities (from earnings/press), and key decision-makers — produce a pre-call account brief with 5 personalized talking points
  • Find buying intent signals for [product category] across 20 target accounts: recent job postings mentioning relevant tools, leadership changes, funding events, tech stack changes, and pain points from reviews — produce a prioritized outbound list
  • Research [prospect name + company]: their LinkedIn background, recent posts and talks, company priorities, competitive tools they use, and mutual connections — produce a hyper-personalized outreach sequence with 3 email drafts
  • Analyze how the top 10 companies in [sector] position and sell [product type]: pricing pages, case studies, sales collateral, G2 comparisons, and objection patterns from reviews — produce a competitive battle card

Insurance

Regulatory intelligence, market benchmarking, catastrophe analysis, and emerging risk research — from public filings.

  • Research the regulatory landscape for [line of business] insurance across the top 10 US states by premium volume: rate filing decisions, new coverage mandates, pending legislation, and enforcement actions — produce a state-by-state matrix
  • Analyze the latest statutory filings for the top 10 [line of business] insurers: combined ratios, loss reserve development, premium growth, expense ratios, and market share shifts — produce a competitive benchmarking report
  • Research catastrophe losses in [region/peril] over the past 24 months: insured loss estimates by modeler, affected carriers, reinsurance market capacity shifts, and pricing implications — produce a cat loss trends report
  • Research emerging risks in [area, e.g. PFAS / cyber ransomware / climate litigation]: current claims landscape, regulatory developments, coverage disputes, and how top 10 carriers are responding — produce a market intelligence briefing

Finance

Peer comparisons, earnings analysis, M&A comps, and target screening — from public filings and transcripts.

  • Pull the last 8 quarters of financials for [company] and its top 5 peers from SEC filings — build a peer comp with revenue growth, margin trends, leverage ratios, and valuation multiples, flagging outliers
  • Analyze this quarter's earnings across 10 companies in [sector]: management commentary themes, guidance revisions, margin drivers, and capex outlook — produce a sector earnings digest
  • Research all M&A transactions in [sector] over the past 3 years: deal values, multiples paid (EV/Revenue, EV/EBITDA), strategic rationale, and buyer profiles — produce a precedent transaction comp table
  • Screen 50+ potential M&A targets in [sector] against criteria (revenue, growth, margins, geography) — produce a ranked shortlist with valuation estimates, strategic fit scores, and recent developments

Who Spine is for

Founders

High-signal research for fundraising and go-to-market: investor decks, TAM/SAM/SOM, competitive landscapes, GTM plans, and decision memos.

Consultants

Research and deliverables in minutes, not days: strategy decks, RFP responses, market sizing, due diligence, and recurring competitive intelligence.
